findings.description: The Lambda environment variables embed an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform configuration. Secrets stored this way can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, Lambda configuration read access, or deployment tooling, enabling unauthorized use of the associated IAM principal.
The function uses the end-of-life nodejs12.x runtime. Unsupported runtimes no longer receive security updates, leaving the function exposed to known runtime vulnerabilities.
